english.title: Fail to produce driving licence and counterpart
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_

on a road namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to produce for examination your licence and its counterpart
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
driving a motor vehicle on a road believed to have committed offence/to be driver at time of accident
required by constable fail to produce licence plus counterpart

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Counterparts to licences came into force on or after 1 June 1990 (1 January 1991 in the case of licences granted under laws of Northern Ireland). The "counterpart" details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) See offence wording H3311 for failure to produce an LGV /PCV licence to an authorised officer other than a constable, and H37 for failure to produce a driving licence
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant,

(A)_[having been the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[who was suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing to its presence]_
(C)_[who was suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), failed to produce a current driving licence and its counterpart to a police constable when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Methu dangos trwydded yrru a'i phapurmanylion
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), pan ofynnwyd i chi wneud hynny gan gwnstabl, bu i chi fethu dangos eich trwydded a'i phapur manylion i'w harchwilio
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) bu i'r diffynnydd,

(A)_[a oedd yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[a oedd yn cael ei amau o yrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[a oedd yn cael ei amau o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), fethu dangos trwydded yrru gyfredol a'i phapur manylion i gwnstabl yr heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu o fewn saith niwrnod wedi hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 164(6) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
